mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash, display_name, department, email, phone, is_active, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM user WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, username, password_hash, display_name, department, email, phone, is_active, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM user WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT id, username, password_hash, display_name, department, email, phone, is_active, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM user ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (username, password_hash, display_name, department, email, phone, is_active) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{department}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET is_active = #{isActive} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user SET last_login_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM user_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId}

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM user_role ur INNER JOIN user u ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE r.code = 'ADMIN' AND u.is_active = 1
AND u.id != #{excludeUserId}
